Examination shows nontender, irregular, hyperkeratotic sessile lesions in the perianal area around 4вЂ“7 mm in diameter. There is no lymphadenopathy. The application of a dilute solution of acetic acid turns the lesions white. What is the most likely cause of the lesions?
